**Commands**

/new · /tab-next · /tab-prev · /tab-close · /tabs-close
/pane-next · /pane-prev · /split · /split-down · /unsplit
/search · /resume · /projects · /project · /project info
/project-new · /project-edit · /project-delete
/project-source-add · /project-source-remove
/model · /effort · /temporary · /attach · /filter
/sync · /delete · /rename · /copy · /remove · /clear
/settings · /session · /actions · /action ID · /exit

Ctrl+A selects text, Ctrl+C copies a selection, Ctrl+V pastes.
Only provider-published thinking is shown. Provider retention rules apply to temporary chats.
F1 closes this help.

{navigation}
